name: Living Grounds
notes: Added original-pixel fire, water, waterfall, light and small sail/leaf animation masks for the thirteen reference scenes. The churchyard gate opens as the player approaches; brazier occlusion follows tighter silhouettes. Added painted connection strips between church/town and town/harbour while retaining every original image unchanged. Continuous full-scale painted ground replaces compressed tile miniatures; dungeon floor sampling keeps each campaign theme. Private development candidate. Full exterior perimeter integration, all dungeon architecture and installed Windows acceptance are not yet complete.
